Hi Olivia — great to meet earlier today. Thanks for the time — below is a quick recap and the pricing estimate we discussed. I attached the PDF version of the deck: Redwood_Pricing_Estimate_LumenWorks_v1.pdf.

Recap (30 min discovery):
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for search ranking and chat by 40-60% while keeping hosting costs predictable.
- Current footprint: mix of on-prem GPUs + burst to cloud; needing VPC options and audit logs for compliance.
- Key constraints: must support SSO and customer-managed KMS; rollout in Q3.

What I included in the attached estimate:
- Option A (Hosted API, reserved throughput): predicts 99th %-tile latency under 300ms for your 1.5M monthly tokens, with predictable monthly commit.
- Option B (Private VPC deployment): on-prem friendly stack with dedicated capacity and KMS/HSM integrations.
- Implementation & onboarding timeline, and a small pilot plan for the initial 2-week performance validation.

Next steps I suggested on the call:
1) Review the attached estimate with engineering and security (I included the compliance checklist appendix).
2) If it looks good, schedule a 45-minute walkthrough with product + infra — I can walk through the pricing line items and the rollout plan.
3) I can open a draft SOW and provide a dataflow diagram for your security team.

Would you be available for a walkthrough next week (Mon/Tue preferred)? If not, tell me a good time and I’ll coordinate.

Thanks — happy to tailor the numbers if your expected usage profile is different.

Best,
